day_shape: 77 items: IRGC claims downing of 54th US MQ-9 and torching of two tankers over the Strait of Hormuz, Pakistan army chief Asim Munir arrives in Tehran, IDF reports 540+ southern Lebanon sites dismantled, Trump claims Iran has killed 75,000 protesters, two UK parliamentary questions tabled on Iran.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz incident claims
threads.summary: IRGC-linked channels said Iran's air defence destroyed a 54th US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz and set two 'violating' oil tankers ablaze. Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri blamed the US and Araghchi called for diplomacy, while the US denied an Iranian claim that a strike injured two soldiers.

threads.label: Pakistan army chief Tehran visit
threads.summary: Pakistan army chief Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir arrived in Tehran with a delegation of officials, reported by IRIB, Mehr and the Jerusalem Post. Defa Press cited Bagheri saying Pakistan has told Iran the closed land border will reopen once technical issues are resolved.

threads.label: IDF operations in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said more than 540 Hezbollah infrastructure sites were dismantled in Al-Khiam, Tayr Harfa, Meiss El Jabal and Majdal Zoun, and separately that three Hamas weapons depots were destroyed in Gaza last week. The IDF also said two Palestinians were struck by drone after crossing the Yellow Line, and alleged the Lebanese Army had failed to address a Hezbollah asset in Kfarra.

threads.label: Russia, China, Qatar diplomacy around Tehran
threads.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov visited Tehran and pledged continued political and economic cooperation, while China's premier met Iran's first vice president urging dialogue and the Qatari and Iranian energy ministers held talks. Trump welcomed what he described as limited Russian and Chinese support for Iran.

threads.label: Yemen front and Houthi activity
threads.summary: At least 18 people were killed in a Houthi attack on a Yemeni government training camp in Shabwa, while Defa Press claimed Yemeni army advances in Taiz against Saudi-backed forces. The US State Department marked five years since Houthi detention of more than twenty US Embassy Sana'a staff.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported at least 15 women and girls killed in a month, mass police text warnings over social media activity, and an 18-year-old killed by a gunshot to the eye after arrest. Trump told a Kansas rally Iran had killed at least 75,000 protesters over eight months, and former president Khatami's criticism of Iran's Palestine policy drew pushback.

threads.label: UK, OFAC and sanctions traffic
threads.summary: OFAC published a notice removing one or more persons from the SDN List, and two UK parliamentary questions were tabled — Lord Leigh on Israel-Arab cooperation against Houthi threats, and Ben Obese-Jecty on the impact of UK support for US Operation Econ. Iran International also reported Iran Air's chief saying 30–40 operational aircraft were destroyed in the war.
